name: Calvin Haze
style: Streetwear-leaning casual. Loves clean silhouettes that slip on without bending over.
shopping_habits: Weekend shopper alongside his wife Martha. Watches sneaker drops on social, hunts for hands-free slip-in technology for the gym, errands, and weekend coffee runs. Not a loyalty-program completionist — buys what looks good and wears-in right.
tech_comfort: Digital-native, mobile-first, lives on Instagram and TikTok for shoe inspo. Expects the site to reflect what he saw scrolling.
